claims.text: Spectre hunting is centuries old but became a respectable trade only when ordinary wraiths took it up; the first Doomslayers were more mercenary than military.

Bands of five to eight hunters joined for safety and profit; most Necropoli paid Charon's bounty for each confirmed kill, proven by a piece of Corpus checked by a Pardoner, and some added rewards for troublesome Spectres.

title: Industrion
summary: A Spectral works deep in the Labyrinth.

claims.text: The main chamber of Industrion was dug square by Spectres and is filled with scaffolding around the World Factory, with a waste shaft about three miles long running straight through it.
Broken vehicles and machinery litter the passages for a day's march around it, and pipes carry plasm and the products of Tempest-weaving in and out.
